verdicts.reason: A follows a sensible left-to-right order (logo, can, headline and subline, CTA), but the SOLSTICE wordmark is tiny and hard to read, the can is shrunk to a small icon, and there is a large dead gap with a stray dot between the copy and the CTA. B jams the can against the left edge and nearly crops it top and bottom so it is barely recognisable, and it drops the logo into the middle between the headline and the CTA, which breaks the reading order and leaves the brand floating as an orphaned fragment.
